purpose: Raw public-market capture for future temporal QA; no signals, orders, accounts or investment evaluation.
authentication: none; reject private/authenticated channels and order methods

market.verification: One REST metadata response; exact v2 instrument snapshot/subscription and applicable Spanish-host access pending.
market.scientific_account_currency: USD remains unchanged; retain native EUR prices, no implicit EUR/USD conversion.

activation_requirements: Separate user approval of source, rights, finite resource envelope and host.
Current terms assessment explicitly addressing own-use public-feed storage/retention; seek clarification only if needed, never presume redistribution rights.
Finite instrument-channel preflight: exact BTC/EUR entry online with preserved base/quote/increments; fail on absent or ambiguous mapping.
Acknowledge both channel subscriptions and bbo trigger; reject any channel/symbol/trigger mismatch.
Host clock synchronization and persistent local disk verified; dependencies and host costs separately authorized.

semantics.trade: Keep original trade_id per book, taker side/order type and exact RFC3339 event timestamp. Snapshot overlap is explicitly marked.
semantics.ticker: Capture supplied best bid/ask and quantities on documented bbo PRICE-level changes; not guaranteed every size-only update or complete order flow. Ignore rolling statistics for signal generation.
semantics.timestamp: Record raw frame receipt with UTC time_ns and monotonic_ns immediately upon delivery to collector, before parsing; this is application receipt, not NIC/exchange receipt. Preserve source event timestamp separately. Parse numbers as Decimal and timestamps exactly, reject precision beyond ns.
semantics.acknowledgements: time_in/time_out describe subscription acknowledgement, never per-trade local receipt.

storage.format: Append-only raw UTF-8 frame journal plus envelope: session_id, local_sequence, received_utc_ns, received_monotonic_ns, frame_sha256, channel/symbol if parsed, schema/config/source hashes. Retain undecodable frames and error reason.
storage.segments: Rotate at 16 MiB or 300 seconds; atomically finalize segment checksum/count/first-last local sequence and fsync manifest; maintain checksum-linked immutable manifests.
storage.retention: Initial finite pilot: retain all raw and normalized QA content privately until explicit review. At approved duration/disk boundary stop cleanly; no silent ring-buffer overwrite or deletion. Future deletion requires versioned retention policy and tombstone audit.

continuity.trade_duplicate_key: venue + original v2 symbol + trade_id, with payload-hash conflict check; retain every raw delivery, suppress only repeated logical effect. Without ID retain row provenance and do not collapse equal value/timestamps.
continuity.ticker_identity: session_id + local_sequence; equal payload or timestamp is not evidence of duplicate exchange event. No provider sequence/checksum promised by ticker.
continuity.gap_policy: Record disconnect intervals, parser/write failures and local sequence breaks; trade-ID jumps are diagnostic, not conclusive missing trades. No fabricated events or silent gap repair.
continuity.reconnection: New session ID, persisted last durable checkpoint, exponential jittered reconnect delays 5..60 seconds and at most 10 attempts/10 minutes; recover instrument/status and snapshots before marking state fresh. Preserve old/new snapshots and overlapping trade deliveries.
continuity.snapshot_limit: Latest 50 trades cannot ensure complete backfill; unknown interval remains unknown. No REST data backfill under this specification without additional scope.
continuity.shutdown: On stop/limit/storage failure, disable reconnect, stop subscription intake, flush bounded buffer, close/fsync journal and manifest; if flush fails mark session incomplete. On restart verify hashes and complete prefix, retain partial tail separately and never silently truncate original bytes.

proposed_finite_pilot_limits.overflow_action: Stop and record gap/limit, do not drop silently.
proposed_finite_pilot_limits.meaning: Operational trial bounds to authorize later, not current execution permission or permanent research/data-horizon limits.

hosting.requirements: One always-on process with supervised restart, stable TLS outbound connection, synchronized UTC clock, persistent disk, restricted filesystem access, rotation and actionable offline/disk/clock alerts. No inbound public service required.
options: Personal computer: no new server fee but power/network/sleep interruptions need measurement; cannot promise 24/7 continuity.
Small hosted VM: 1 vCPU/1 GiB RAM proposed starting envelope, at least 20 GiB persistent disk; quote provider/region/transfer/backups before approval.
hosting.resource_model: Raw bytes/day = mean_frames_per_second * mean_frame_bytes * 86400, plus envelopes/indexes. At 10 frames/s and1024 bytes/frame:884736000 bytes/day; at100 frames/s:8847360000 bytes/day. These are sensitivity examples, not measured Kraken rates. Compression benefit not assumed.
hosting.costs: No provider selected or quoted. Public authentication-free access does not mean free hosting, unlimited rights or guaranteed service.

future_acceptance: No order/auth methods emitted; only allowlisted public subscriptions.
Exact frame receipt clocks and payload hashes survive restart; corrupt/partial tails detected.
Duplicate trades cannot double logical effects; equal-value distinct IDs preserved.
Disconnect leaves explicit unknown-coverage interval despite snapshot recovery.
bbo acknowledgement and observed change semantics recorded; do not overclaim size-only coverage.
Disk/duration/backpressure stop conditions exercised on synthetic frames before activation.
